BETA Close X Bellway PLC has announced the purchase of 222,229 ordinary shares between April 13 and April 17, 2026, as part of its share buyback program. The highest price paid per share was 2,010.00 GBp and the lowest was 1,935.00 GBp, with a volume-weighted average price of 1,970.60 GBp on the London Stock Exchange. These shares will be cancelled, reducing the total number of ordinary shares in issue to 115,930,303. Disclaimer* Bellway PLC 20 April 2026 Bellway p.l.c. Transaction in Own Shares 20 April 2026 Bellway p.l.c. ('Bellway' or the 'Group') announces that, in accordance with the terms of the share buyback programme (the 'Buyback Programme') announced on 14 October 2025 and the terms of the Second Tranche announced on 2 April 2026, from 13 April 2026 up to and including 17 April 2026 the Group purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 12.5 pence each (the Ordinary Shares') through Deutsche Bank AG. Date Number of shares purchased Highest price paid (GBp) Lowest price paid (GBp) Volume weighted average price (GBp) Trading venue 13 April 2026 51,000 1,961.00 1,935.00 1,952.67 XLON 14 April 2026 50,500 1,986.00 1,961.00 1,977.18 XLON 15 April 2026 50,900 1,987.00 1,945.00 1,960.76 XLON 16 April 2026 50,000 2,010.00 1,973.00 1,993.82 XLON 17 April 2026 24,829 1,990.00 1,954.00 1,967.54 XLON The purchased Ordinary Shares will be cancelled. Since the announcement of the Second Tranche of the Buyback Programme on 2 April 2026, Bellway has purchased 392,779 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for cancellation. Bellway has now purchased 3,351,095 Ordinary Shares under the first and second tranche (to date) in aggregate for cancellation under the Buyback Programme. Following settlement of the above purchases and cancellation of the purchased ordinary shares, the Group's total number of ordinary shares in issue shall be 115,930,303 ordinary shares. In accordance with Article 5(1)(b) of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 as it applies in the UK (the Market Abuse Regulation), the table below contains detailed information of the individual trades made by Deutsche Bank AG on behalf of Bellway as part of the Buyback Programme.
